labelling_contract: Flat and keyed by normalized option text, carrying no role, no key marker, no item id and no position. Competitor labels are the frozen seed enrichment's own tags, written before any G2 scenario existed. Key labels were assigned from the option text and the closed axis definition alone. Stated residual risk, as at G0: the party assigning the key labels had seen the keys, and the structural bounds are that every value is a choice from a closed enumeration and that no entry can express a role, a key or an item identity.
